newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rates steady around 3.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money rates steady around 3.05 pct.

text.p: German overnight call rates were steady between 3.0 and 3.10 percent on Tuesday with the market finding ample liquidity.
Traders said they expect rates to remain around current levels until about the middle of the month when tighter conditions could push rates up.
Some said that if the Bundesbank wants to steer rates back toward 3.10 percent it could drain about two billion marks in Wednesday's securities repurchase allocation.
Credit institutions held 41.5 billion marks with the Bundesbank on Monday, up from 40 billion marks on Friday.
The average for the month was 40.9 billion marks. Banks borrowed about 100 million marks from the Lombard lending window.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= stood at 3.09292 percent, down slightly from 3.10067 percent on Monday.
